thread:
Lin: Heads-up: planned schema tweak + tenant-scoped backfill tomorrow 03:00 UTC. Please ack if you can monitor.
Lin: Plan detail: add column orders.metadata_checksum (nullable), run tenant-scoped backfill in small slices (by order_id ranges) to avoid long-running row locks. No index or FK changes.
Priya: ACK. Which service owns the writer spike?
Lin: Order ingestion service; we've scoped to background-only tenants first.
Marco: What exact DDL and backfill job are we using?
Lin: DDL is trivial: ALTER TABLE orders ADD COLUMN metadata_checksum text; Backfill job = checksum-worker v1.9.2 running with slice_size=2000 and sleep_ms=150 between slices.
Lin: Backfill SQL (simplified):
```sql
ALTER TABLE orders ADD COLUMN metadata_checksum text;
-- worker computes sha1(jsonb_strip_nulls(metadata)) per row
UPDATE orders SET metadata_checksum = encode(digest(jsonb_strip_nulls(metadata)::text, 'sha1'), 'hex')
WHERE metadata IS NOT NULL AND metadata_checksum IS NULL
AND order_id BETWEEN $start AND $end
LIMIT $slice_size;
```
Priya: Good to know. Canary strategy?
Lin: Canary: 1% tenants (low-volume), run 2 waves spaced 3 minutes apart. Holdpoint at 10% ramp. If stable, ramp 10 -> 25 -> 50 over 20m. Final catch-up in low-traffic window at 23:00 UTC.
Marco: Pin suggestion: if rollback needed, pin checksum-worker to v1.9.0. Production rollback steps?
Lin: Stop worker, leave column in place (non-destructive). If we must fully revert, run `ALTER TABLE orders DROP COLUMN metadata_checksum;` in maintenance window.
deploybot: canary launch for thread 1787654321 started: canary id cb-178765, subset=1% tenants, start=03:05 UTC.
srebot: Dashboards: https://grafana.company/internal/d/orders_checksum_backfill - watch deadlocks, tx duration, replica lag. Synthetic load test link: https://perf.company/tests/178765.
Priya: Abort criteria: sustained write p95 > +2s vs baseline, deadlock rate >0.5/min, replica lag >45s.
Lin: Also abort if any 5xx increase from order ingestion service.
Marco: Add a safety throttle: if lock_wait_time_avg >150ms, reduce slice_size to 500 and increase sleep_ms to 400.
Lin: Implemented an automatic throttle rule in the worker config.
deploybot: canary cb-178765: wave1 complete, 3.4k rows processed, no deadlocks, avg tx +60ms.
Priya: monitoring shows small p50 increase, p95 flat. OK to proceed to wave2.
Marco: ops/team note: if we need to hotfix ingestion schema assumptions, we can pin ingestion-api to 2.12.1.
Lin: Holdpoint at 03:20 before >10% ramp.
srebot: No alerts. Replica lag steady.
deploybot: cb-178765: wave2 complete, 9.7k rows, transient lock_wait spike 220ms for ~30s, auto-throttle engaged reducing slice_size to 500.
Priya: Good catch on auto-throttle. Any missed rows due to throttle?
Lin: Worker retries on transient failures; no rows lost. We'll run final verification scan.
Marco: Add to release notes: "orders.metadata_checksum column + staged tenant backfill (background only). Backfill includes auto-throttle safeguards."
Lin: I'll append full counts and links after final catch-up.

Lin: Noted 97 we'll delay final sweep until vacuum completes.
deploybot: ramp to 10% begun per holdpoint.
Priya: If anything goes sideways, stop worker and revert by dropping column in maintenance only. Make an incident channel if abort.

Lin: Closing comments: will post follow-up with total updated rows and any postmortem notes.
